equip_instructions: Read verified_facts[] — every fact carries a source and a date. Cite the date with the number.
Read no_go_lines[] — each forbidden claim carries a reason you can explain on the record.
Before you speak, run your draft through deny_patterns[] (the same list the on-page checker uses). If a pattern hits, rewrite.
Answer press questions only from likely_questions[].approved_answer; a question you don't have an answer for is a question you escalate to hp@cumulativeweb.com.

item.description: The Press department's pre-interview briefing room — the Agent Deck gear line's answer to hallucination on the record. An agent equips GREENROOM before speaking about an artist: 10 verified facts each with source and date, 6 approved angles, 6 no-go lines each carrying its reason, 11 likely questions with approved answers, and a machine-readable deny-pattern list for scanning drafts before they go public. Complements the Press Kit Cartridge (the facts) and Copy Desk (the story units): GREENROOM is the briefing BEFORE speaking. Walk in prepared, never improvise on the record.
item.name: GREENROOM
